title: Makharij: the empty space and the throat: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Ghashiyah, the makharij and the rules of laam
source: Written for quran/y5 lesson 10 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Makharij rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 10. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

head: Not this
This
rows: عَيْنٍ said like 'ayn' with a hamza
Press the middle of the throat for ع: 'ayn

keywords.def: the exit point where a letter's sound is made (plural makharij, مخارج)
the empty space of the mouth and throat

questions.q: Say عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍۢ (88:5) and name where each first letter comes from.
questions.a: ع: middle of the throat; ء: deepest part of the throat.

questions.q: Which letters come from the deepest part?
Makharij map (pupil PDF): label the throat diagram with ء ه ع ح غ خ. Today's rota group recites 88:1 to 5 to the teacher in turn.
questions.a: Deepest ء ه; middle ع ح; nearest the mouth غ خ.

questions.q: Extend: write one word from 88:1 to 5 for each throat part.
questions.a: ء or ه: هَلْ (88:1); ع or ح: عَامِلَةٌ (88:3); غ or خ: ٱلْغَٰشِيَةِ (88:1).

questions.q: Stretch: why are the throat letters the izhar letters?
questions.a: They are far from where the noon is made (the tongue tip), so the noon stays clear.
A) The middle of the throat. ع and ح are from the middle of the throat. The lips make ب م و ف; the tongue tip makes letters like ت د.

questions.q: Think again: Put your hand on your throat and say 'aa', then ''a' (ع). Which one do you feel? Where does each sound start?
questions.a: 'Aa' flows from the empty space of the mouth and throat (jawf); ع is pressed in the middle of the throat.
